{"sha":"d2f3f88e3b8166075801465bc4893e0433b6bf43","html_url":"https://github.com/AI-Riksarkivet/rask/commit/d2f3f88e3b8166075801465bc4893e0433b6bf43","commit":{"author":{"name":"Borg93","email":"Borg93@users.noreply.github.com","date":"2026-10-23T07:44:08Z"},"committer":{"name":"Borg93","email":"Borg93@users.noreply.github.com","date":"2026-10-23T07:44:08Z"},"message":"feat(catalog,maintenance): LH-526 — a name is NFC text with no `$`, `+`, `/`, control character or edge whitespace, and a `+` in the path reads as a space (ADR 0173 §4)

The router judges a request's shape between identity and authorization (`authenticate`, then
`fga_deps.require_request_names`, then `authorize`), so a malformed request answers 400 before any grant is asked. It
refuses a `?delimiter` other than the spec's `$` (`spec.yaml:2314-2318`), and every segment a naming door is handed that
is not a name (`identifiers.require_names`): the path id of create, declare, register and namespace and view create, a
rename's destination and a batch's ids. A name is Unicode NFC text of 1 to 255 characters with no `$`, `+`, `/` or
control character and no edge whitespace, refused and never rewritten; `*` and `?` are names again, since no name
reaches a vended policy. A create at the root id answers 400 there too.

The catalog reads its path from `raw_path` (`catalog.api.path_reading`, outermost): a bare `+` is a space, as pylance's
Rust `RestNamespace` sends one, a `%2B` stays a `+` and is refused, and a `%2F` is refused 400 before routing. The
read-only and signing gates classify a write by the path routing matched rather than `request.url.path`, which ended
the path at a `?` in a name, so a namespace create named `describe?` read as a describe and passed the read-only window.

The register door refuses a location segment holding `${`. `vending.IAM_POLICY_SYNTAX` (`*`, `?`, `${`) is the one
rule for every value a vended policy names: the register door, the table prefix check, the writer-chosen base drop and
the branch refusal.

The delimiter is the spec's `$` and nothing sets it (LH-150): `LANCE_NS_DELIMITER`, `MAINTENANCE_DELIMITER`,
`SEED_NS_DELIMITER` with `--delimiter` and the seed's `{delimiter}` placeholder, `LANCE_E2E_DELIM`, the chart env, the
compose line and both Dagger lanes' env go. `parse_identifier`, `fga.canonical_object_id`, `fga.parent_namespace_id`
and every catalog and maintenance helper lose their `delimiter` parameter, and the `settings` parameters that read only
it. The warehouse door's depth check goes: its control-id name holds no delimiter, so it is one segment.

Review round (Standards, Spec): two comments named a module that does not exist, and a test docstring carried history.
The shape rung had re-derived a rename's destination and a batch's ids beside the doors that act on them. Now
`identifiers.rename_destination` is the one rule the door, `dataplane.rename_table`, the tier judge's input and the rung
ask, and one walker reads a batch's ids for its authorization and its shape. That also aligns the tier judge, which had
read an empty `new_namespace_id` as the root. Parked LOW: `path_reading` decodes `raw_path` as ASCII, as uvicorn already
does before the app sees it.

Red checks in a snapshot worktree, 18 mutations over the catalog, integration and unit suites, each red only on the
cases written for it: the rung judging no names (eleven naming-door refusals, three governed names), the rung placed
after `authorize` and a delimiter setting read (the governed test), `+` not read as a space (the stock client's
`sp ace`), `%2F` routed (its slash case), `${` dropped from the IAM syntax (register, prefix and branch), each gate
reading `request.url.path` (its `describe?` case), each branch of the name rule (its cases), and the shared rename and
batch readers answering nothing (their cases, and the tier judge's rename into silver).

tests: +3 −10 (test_a_shape_refusal_answers_before_authorization.py +1, replacing
test_the_delimiter_is_not_silently_ignored.py −3; test_a_naming_door_refuses_a_segment_that_is_not_a_name.py +2,
replacing test_wildcard_guard_is_wired_at_every_minting_door.py −4; test_cross_axis_identity.py −2 and
test_namespace_depth_cap.py −1, whose premise was a configurable delimiter. Cases added to existing tests: `sp ace` in
the off-cluster stock-client test, `${` raw and encoded in the register spelling test, a `${` prefix and branch in
the vending tests, and a `describe?` namespace in the read-only and signing gate tests; the idempotency test's wildcard
case goes, since the router refuses a name before any door claims a key)
